About K-Boringen:With its trenchless installation of pipelines and tunnels, K-Boringen has built a groundbreaking international reputation. Equipped with an extensive fleet of machinery and supported by more than 55 expert employees, K-Boringen guarantees an extremely smooth and flexible service, even in the most challenging work situations. To ensure continued growth, we are currently looking for new colleagues.

Being naturally multilingual and equipped with an impressive machine park, the people at K-Boringen ensure an exceptionally smooth and flexible collaboration, even in the most demanding work conditions.

Using tunnel boring machines, our professionals drill (micro)tunnels with diameters of up to 4 meters over lengths of, for example, 1 km. More information can be found at https://www.k-boringen.com/.

To carry out our drilling projects across Europe, we are looking for motivated, competent employees who have a sense of responsibility and adventure. Our target group consists of workers who are eager to work—especially on-site abroad—who are flexible and skilled in languages.

Basic Requirements:

• Knowledge of hydraulics, welding, and cutting is a plus.
• A solid understanding of electricity is a must.
• Troubleshooting various malfunctions is a challenge for the ideal candidate.
• Preferably, some initial work experience as a laborer and a flexible mindset.
• Willingness to perform physically demanding and dirty work (but done calmly rather than hastily).
• No fear of confined spaces (claustrophobia).
• Fluent in Dutch (additional languages are a plus); if you can communicate well in English, German, or French, you may also qualify.
• Flexibility regarding location and work schedule.
Additional Information:

• You will primarily work within the country, but also regularly in Belgium’s neighboring countries (NL, DE, etc.).
• You will stay on-site from Monday to Friday. During weekends, you return home (you also receive a daily allowance for accommodation).
• You will not work every week of the year; there will be both busy periods (when execution takes place) and quieter periods.
• A driver’s license is not required.
